```{=html}
<section class="band band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow">Getting here</p>

    <h2 class="section-title">Travel &amp; Stay</h2>

    <p class="date-place" style="text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0.04em; font-size:1rem">
      The wedding is at the Fontainebleau Inn in Alpine, New York &mdash; tucked on Cayuta Lake,
      about half an hour south of Ithaca and twenty-odd minutes east of Watkins Glen. Most of our
      guests stay in downtown Ithaca, and we are running a shuttle so nobody has to think about
      driving.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <p class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">Where to stay</p>

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Downtown Ithaca</h2>

    <p style="text-align:center; max-width:620px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.8">
      These three are our picks. All are walkable to the Commons, to dinner, and to the shuttle
      pickup &mdash; so this is the easiest home base for the weekend.
    </p>

    <div class="tbl-wrap">
```

| Where | The vibe | Address | |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Canopy by Hilton Ithaca Downtown** | Newest of the three. Bright, modern rooms right on the edge of the Commons. Our easiest recommendation if you want something fresh and simple. | 324 E State St, Ithaca | [Book](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ithcapy-canopy-ithaca-downtown/) |
| **Ithaca Marriott Downtown on the Commons** | Directly on the Commons, with a rooftop bar. Reliable, central, and the most rooms of the three — good for families. | 120 S Aurora St, Ithaca | [Book](https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/ithdt-ithaca-marriott-downtown-on-the-commons/overview/) |
| **Argos Inn** | For a more unique stay. A restored 1831 brick mansion with just a handful of individually designed rooms and a very good cocktail bar downstairs. | 408 E State St, Ithaca | [Book](https://argosinn.com/) |

```{=html}
    </div>

    <div class="note-strip">
      <strong>Book early.</strong> We are not holding a room block, so rooms are first come,
      first served &mdash; and June is a busy month in Ithaca. It is worth reserving something
      refundable well ahead and deciding later.
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-flowers">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <div class="panel-card">

      <p class="eyebrow">Between downtown and the lawn</p>

      <h2 class="section-title">The Shuttle</h2>

      <p style="line-height:1.8">
        We are running a shuttle between downtown Ithaca and the Fontainebleau Inn so you can
        enjoy the Finger Lakes wine without worrying about the drive back.
      </p>

      <ul style="line-height:2; padding-left:1.2rem">
        <li><strong>Out to the venue</strong> &mdash; one pickup from downtown Ithaca before the ceremony.</li>
        <li><strong>Early return</strong> &mdash; a first run back downtown for anyone calling it a night.</li>
        <li><strong>Late return</strong> &mdash; a second run back downtown at the end of the reception.</li>
      </ul>

      <p style="line-height:1.8; margin-bottom:0">
        Exact pickup spot and times will be posted here closer to the wedding, and will be in your
        invitation. If you are staying out near the lake instead, you are welcome to drive &mdash;
        there is plenty of parking at the Inn.
      </p>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <p class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">Closer to the venue</p>

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Trumansburg &amp; Watkins Glen</h2>

    <p style="text-align:center; max-width:640px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.8">
      If you would rather wake up in the country, there are lovely bed and breakfasts in both
      directions. Trumansburg is where the Friday welcome party is, so staying up that way puts
      you minutes from Taughannock. These are outside the shuttle route, so plan on driving
      &mdash; but they are a charming way to make a weekend of it.
    </p>

    <div class="listing">

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Gothic Eves Inn &amp; Spa</h4>
        <div class="place">Trumansburg</div>
        <p>An 1855 house turned inn with a spa and a well-regarded breakfast. The most full-service option of the bunch, and right in the village where our caterer is based.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Inn B Tween Farm B&amp;B</h4>
        <div class="place">Trumansburg</div>
        <p>An 1848 Greek revival farmhouse set in the hills between Cayuga and Seneca, with five country rooms and a farm-to-table breakfast from their own eggs and preserves.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>The Blackberry Inn</h4>
        <div class="place">Watkins Glen</div>
        <p>A three-room 1830s Greek revival in the village, walkable to Seneca Lake, Watkins Glen State Park, and the shops and restaurants downtown. The closest of these to the venue.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Finger Lakes Cider House</h4>
        <div class="place">Interlaken</div>
        <p>Two yurts and a three-bedroom loft above the tasting room, on an organic orchard farm on Route 89. Genuinely one of our favorite places in the area &mdash; see the Things to Do page.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Lake houses on Cayuta</h4>
        <div class="place">Alpine</div>
        <p>There are several rental houses within walking distance of the Inn on Cayuta Lake. If you are coming as a group and want to be steps from the party, ask us and we will point you to the list.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>The Inn itself</h4>
        <div class="place">Alpine</div>
        <p>The Fontainebleau Inn has eight rooms and sleeps about eighteen. Those are spoken for by our immediate families and wedding party, but we wanted you to know the layout.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="note-strip">
      <strong>Flying in?</strong> The closest airport is Ithaca Tompkins (ITH), about forty
      minutes from the venue. Syracuse (SYR) and Elmira (ELM) are each roughly an hour and a half,
      and both usually have more flights and cheaper fares. You will want a car from any of them.
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band script-banner">
  <div class="plaque">
    <p>Come early, stay late, and make a weekend of the Finger Lakes.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
